audience.text: Developers who generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on a server or in a build pipeline and need to work directly with the Office Open XML file format.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations or load existing .pptx files, add/remove/clone slides, and save to PPTX, PPSX, or POTX formats.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Insert AutoShapes, PictureFrames, Tables, and Connectors with support for 190 ShapeType values, plus solid, gradient, pattern, and picture fills.
capabilities.title: Shape and formatting

capabilities.text: Format text at Portion, Paragraph, and TextFrame levels including bold, italic, underline, size, spacing, caps, and font settings.
capabilities.title: Text formatting

capabilities.text: Apply eight visual effects (outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, fill overlay) and 3D properties to shapes.
capabilities.title: Visual effects and 3D

capabilities.text: Support threaded comments with multiple authors and timestamps, plus speaker notes via NotesSlideManager.
capabilities.title: Comments and notes

capabilities.text: Access and modify core, app, and custom document properties including title, author, subject, keywords, and arbitrary custom values.
capabilities.title: Document properties

capabilities.text: Embed images from files, raw bytes, or InputStreams via ImageCollection.addImage() and attach them to slides using addPictureFrame().
capabilities.title: Image embedding

capabilities.text: Preserve unknown XML parts verbatim during save operations, ensuring round-trip fidelity for content this library does not parse.
capabilities.title: XML preservation

limitations.text: Save() only supports PPTX, PPSX, and POTX formats; all other SaveFormat values raise UnsupportedOperationException.
No support for charts, SmartArt, OLE objects, video, audio, animations, transitions, group shapes, hyperlinks, sections, slide backgrounds, themes, or slide size configuration.
A known defect: cloning a master slide via getMasters().addClone() does not persist the clone to the saved package.
Table.mergeCells() requires an XML-backed table and cannot merge cells on tables built without a backing OOXML element.
Text language attributes are not written to the package; PowerPoint applies the authoring machine's default language instead.
JDK 21 or later is required; the build fails on older JDKs with a readable message.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint presentation generation and modification without Microsoft Office, COM automation, or native dependencies.
Preserves unknown XML content during round-trip operations, ensuring no content loss when loading and saving presentations.
Provides a secure XML parser that rejects DOCTYPE declarations and disables external entities, protecting against XXE attacks.
Supports threaded comments, speaker notes, document properties, and shape formatting through a pure Java API.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and editing PowerPoint .pptx presentations without requiring Microsoft Office or native code.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of getFontName() and its relationship to font handling in the library is not fully described beyond its existence.
The specific implementation details of how Presentation.save() handles streams without explicit format inference are not detailed in the facts.
Whether the library supports reading or writing VBA macros is unclear from the facts provided.

workflows.name: Create and save presentations
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Presentation object, add shapes, format text, and save to PPTX, PPSX, or POTX formats using the save() method.

workflows.name: Modify existing presentations
workflows.text: Load an existing .pptx file using Presentation constructor, modify slides, shapes, or properties, and save changes while preserving unknown XML parts.

workflows.name: Add threaded comments
workflows.text: Create CommentAuthor instances and add threaded comments to slides with timestamps and positions using CommentCollection.addComment().

workflows.name: Format text and shapes
workflows.text: Apply character, paragraph, and frame formatting through PortionFormat, ParagraphFormat, and TextFrameFormat, plus fills, lines, effects, and 3D properties.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Build with Maven using JDK 21+, run tests under tests/, tests/integration/, and tests/conformance/, and produce a CycloneDX SBOM.
